title: Character theory for 2-representations
summary: Group representations very comfortably admit a higher categorical generalization. This includes induction and restriction for 2-representations that very directly parallel classical definitions. An appropriate character theory for 2-representations has been more opaque. In this paper we draw from a range of motivations to provide an intuitive character theory for 2-representations. It is built from the bicategorical trace developed to describe topological fixed point theory.
